title: Safe Vision-Language Models via Unsafe Weights Manipulation

bias_targets.target: Unsafe content bias (Toxicity, Hate, NSFW, Violence)
bias_targets.methodology: The paper evaluates model preferences for safe versus unsafe content using the introduced SafeGround metrics on the ViSU dataset, which spans 20 unsafe concepts (e.g., hate, violence, sexual, harassment). It also measures the percentage of NSFW content generated and toxicity scores (using the Perspective API) for image captioning tasks on LLaVA.

primary_bias_target: Unsafe content bias (Toxicity, Hate, NSFW, Violence)
